objects.description: For [Operation Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014), the threat actors obtained a variety of open source tools, including JexBoss, KeeThief, and [BloodHound](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0521).(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
objects.description_fa: برای [عملیات Wocao](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0014)، عوامل تهدید انواع ابزارهای منبع باز، از جمله JexBoss، KeeThief، و [BloodHound](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0521) را به دست آوردند.(Citation: FoxIT Wocao December 2019)
